tool_args.rationale: The pilot horizons are all at most 0.48, far shorter than the target horizon. The selected probe directly measures the long-horizon behavior needed to distinguish and calibrate slow adaptation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon model from pilot rows alone
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations do not reliably identify the slow adaptation term needed at H=23.4.
Additional fine trajectory measurements are less directly informative about the long-horizon reversal.
The auxiliary measurement does not resolve the temporal identifiability ambiguity.
